summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Charles Lewis Tiffany, a nineteenth-century leader in the American jewelry trade. It gives his lifespan and notes that he founded Tiffany & Co. in New York City in 1837. It also highlights his innovations: the country's first retail catalog and the introduction of the English sterling silver standard for imported jewelry in 1851.
one_line: Charles Lewis Tiffany was a 19th-century American jewelry leader who founded Tiffany & Co. in New York City in 1837.
